source: Karr 2012 + sim_fitted_targeted.mat stored runtime / sim.state.* SS values. Targets reflect Karr's published / extracted ground-truth; tolerances reflect known chassis structural ceilings (e.g., FBA-at-snapshot 0.51x growth ratio per plan and tests/m1/test_karr_metabolism.py).
rationale: Phase E.0 first phenotype validation report. 4 FBA prediction tests (non-circular) + 4 chassis wiring/stability checks (catch composer/integrator bugs; become real predictive tests once M2/M3 v2 mechanics replace prescribed-rate models).

p1_growth_per_s.note: FBA at static snapshot bounds hits ~0.51x of stored (structural ceiling: Karr's enzyme bounds are post-step). Tolerance is asymmetric: 0.40 floor, 1.10 ceiling.

p2_doubling_time_h.note: Inverse of growth -> at 0.51x growth, doubling is ~1.96x stored. Tolerance accommodates.

p3_fba_oracle_median_log2_ratio.note: Median |log2(predicted/stored)| over comparable reactions. Existing acceptance: < 1.0.

p4_glucose_uptake_TX_GLCPTS.fail_reason: STRUCTURAL GAP: TX_GLCPTS is in the 504 FBA col set but Karr's biology routes glucose uptake through non-FBA submodels (PTS sugar phosphotransferase). Under Karr's snapshot bounds the LP solves TX_GLCPTS = 0 because PEP supply is throttled. Test pinned as xfail until M4-M28 wire up the non-FBA PTS process.

p5_mrna_total_chassis_wiring.note: Wiring-fidelity test: build engine -> read mRNA counts from chassis state -> compare SUM to independently-computed m2.expression.sum(). Catches index/copy/topology bugs in the composer. NOT a biology prediction; becomes one once M2 v2 mechanics replace prescribed-rate model.

p6_protein_total_chassis_wiring.note: Wiring-fidelity test for M3 -- same shape as p5.

p7_mrna_stability_over_20s.note: |sum(mRNA, t=20) - sum(mRNA, t=0)| / sum(mRNA, t=0) < tol. Tests chassis SS stability under the analytical-integrator wrapper. Drift=0 by math at SS; this catches integrator bugs, not biology.

p8_protein_stability_over_20s.note: Same shape as p7 for protein counts.

p9_aa_pool_stability_over_20s.note: Phenotype #14: per-AA cytosol pool stability under the full Phase C closed loop (dynamic bounds + throttle + calibrated pool replenishment). max_aa(|delta_pool|/pool) over 20s. Real prediction (not a tautology): M3 drains 20 distinct AAs at protein-composition-weighted rates while M1 sources them at calibrated baseline-demand rates -- match-up is a stoichiometric+rate test of the closed loop, not the analytical SS of any single process.

p10_cell_dry_mass_g.source: sim.state.State_Mass.dump.cellDry total (sim_fitted_targeted.mat) ingested into karr_native_m1.json stored_runtime.cell_dry_total_mass_g
p10_cell_dry_mass_g.fail_reason: STRUCTURAL GAP exposed by the mass aggregator: M2 v1 wires Karr's expression[:,0] (transcription-rate field, total ~41327 normalized units) as if it were mature-RNA SS counts. Karr's actual SS mature-RNA count is 784 molecules across 347 species (cytosol). Aggregator therefore over-counts RNA mass ~53x -> total mass ~9.7e-15 g vs target 3.94e-15 g (2.46x). Substrate side also bogus: chassis seeds 561 non-demand substrates at 1.0 placeholder vs Karr's snapshot counts. Pinned xfail until m2-counts-fix lands; flips green when M2 SS reads State_Rna.counts[matureIndexs, c=0] (TU->gene split) and chassis substrates are seeded from Karr's snapshot.
